result.summary: The page layout appears mostly intact, with one notable inconsistency in heart icon styling between promotional cards.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has a white circular background, while the heart icon on the pizza card below has a dark circular background, creating visual inconsistency between similar card elements.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon button styling (background color/opacity) across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.
